title: Checkpoint Selection and Evaluation in EEG Emotion Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2607.27655v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Checkpoint selection can improve an electroencephalography (EEG) emotion-recognition score without improving performance on other trials. We compared selection and scoring on disjoint trial pools along fixed training trajectories. A same-session SEED study comprised 300 trajectories from 15 participants, two models and five trial-role rotations. Another 276 trajectories extended the comparison to separate training, validation and target sessions in SEED, SEED-IV and SEED-V, with 15, 15 and 16 participants, respectively. translated_title: 脑电图情绪识别中的检查点选择与评估
translated_abstract: 检查点选择可以在不提高其他试验表现的情况下改善脑电图（EEG）情绪识别分数。我们在固定的训练轨迹上，对不相交的试验池进行了选择与评分的比较。一项同会话SEED研究包括来自15名参与者的300条训练轨迹、两个模型和五种试验角色轮换。另外276条轨迹将比较扩展到SEED、SEED-IV和SEED-V数据集中相互分离的训练、验证和目标会话，参与者人数分别为15、15和16名。将候选检查点集从五个增加到80个，使同会话动态图卷积神经网络（DGCNN）在选择池上的分数提高了6.24个百分点，而其他池的变化为-1.24（描述性95%参与者自助置信区间为-2.67至0.26）。在跨会话设计下，DGCNN在三个数据集上分别保留了4.47 [1.79, 7.25]、4.27 [2.00, 6.53]和2.75 [0.79, 4.78]个百分点的增益。
tldr: 该研究通过在不相交试验池上的系统比较，揭示了脑电图情绪识别中检查点选择带来的分数提升无法泛化到其他试验，表明这种提升可能是选择偏差而非真实性能改进。
en_tdlr: This study reveals through systematic comparison on disjoint trial pools that checkpoint selection gains in EEG emotion recognition do not generalize to other trials, suggesting such improvements reflect selection bias rather than genuine performance enhancement.
